### Problem
A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you are facing. (e.g., "I'm always frustrated when...")

### Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how you envision the feature working.

### Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

### Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
